messages:
Anika: Quick sync: draft a launch checklist for long-term routing/policy work that maps to customer promises and the Q3 roadmap. Keep it minimal and testable.
Ravi: We need measurable ops gates: per-tenant p99 delta, queue depth thresholds, and automatic quarantine rules.
Diego: Implementation-wise, prefer fine-grained flags and a rollout API that supports percent traffic and variant targeting. No global flips.
Priya: Key gating matrix rows: Observability (per-tenant + per-variant metrics), Isolation test (noisy tenant experiment), Quality (eval on customer prompts for quantized variants), Compliance (residency honored + audit logs).
Sofia: From sales: customers demand 1) hard residency option, 2) burst pool sizing guidance, and 3) contract language for failover behavior.
Anika: Proposed minimal launch gates: 1) Telemetry: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 + cost attribution for 30d, 2) Canary: rollout to <=0.5% with auto-rollback, 3) Isolation: synthetic noisy tenant test (neighbors p99 delta <5%), 4) Economics: median cost delta <=12% on baselines, 5) Compliance: residency flag verified by audit test.
Ravi: Ops thresholds suggestion: alert when p95 rises >20% for 5m, auto-throttle to reserved_qps if error budget hit, quarantine after 60s sustained anomaly.
Diego: Sample routing snippet (intent):
```
routing_policy:
  - id: committed_residency
    match: tenant.residency == "eu" and tenant.tier == "committed"
    action: route_to: eu-reserved-pool
  - id: quant_fallback
    match: model_variant in ["quant4_kv"]
    action: prefer: quant_pool
  - fallback: regional-affinity -> global-fallback
```
Priya: Add a model-variant gate: any automatic routing to quantized variants must pass an eval delta <1% vs baseline, otherwise require explicit opt-in. Record results in audit log.
Sofia: I will draft two contract bullets: (A) "hard residency": traffic never leaves region X unless customer enables failover, (B) "burst pool": documented size + refill policy.
Anika: Owners & near-term asks: Priya -> full gating matrix (Tue), Diego -> RFC for controller + rollout API (Wed), Ravi -> load test plan + runbook (Wed), Sofia -> customer checklist + contract language (Thu). ops-bot: Staging deploy window Thu 02:00-05:00 UTC. Tag PRs with "routing-checklist".
Ravi: Runbook outline: detect -> notify -> throttle -> evict -> failover -> postmortem. Auto-rollback hook available to canary service.
Diego: One open question: treat model_variant as separate isolation dimension? Priya: Yes, treat variant as first-class match key and include per-variant telemetry in SLOs.
Anika: Good. Let's reconvene Friday 10am to review the gating matrix and RFC. Keep these notes short so they can be copied into the roadmap doc. Thanks :thumbsup:
